Privacy

Overview

This is the personal portfolio of Leo Battiste. You can browse Work, Journal, and the Playground without creating an account. This policy explains what the website collects and how that information is used.

The public website does not run ads or use third-party advertising or analytics trackers.

Visits

To understand how the site is used, it records the page visited, time of the visit, referring website when available, and a random visitor identifier associated with your browser tab.

The identifier is kept in session storage. The site's own analytics do not use cookies or deliberately collect your IP address. If your browser sends a Do Not Track signal, the site skips this page-view recording.

The hosting provider may process technical information, including IP addresses, to deliver the site and protect its services.

Messages

When you send a message through the contact form, the name, email address, and message you provide are stored so I can read and respond to you. Please avoid sending sensitive information through this form.

Appearance

Your light or dark theme preference is saved in your browser's local storage. It is not sent to the site's database. You can clear it at any time by clearing the site's local storage.

The temporary identifier used for page-view counting is kept separately in session storage.

Services and external links

Supabase stores website content, contact messages, and page-view records. Hosting services process the information required to deliver the site. They may keep technical logs under their own policies.

Some pages link to other websites and services. When you follow those links, their own privacy policies apply.

Retention and security

Contact messages and visit information are kept as needed to operate the website, review activity, and manage correspondence. Access to stored information is restricted, but no online service can guarantee complete security.

If you want to ask about a message you sent or request its deletion, email hey@leobattiste.com. Requests will be reviewed in line with applicable law.

Changes

This policy may change when the website or its services change. The latest version will appear on this page.
